items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: when I interviewed Art Blakey, because I was a feature writer for the “Melody Maker” by then

ctx.x: Yeah. Fair enough. No I don’t think so. I think most of the guys that came over, I mean I’ve interviewed quite a number of older guys from New Orleans or some of the younger, sharper cats. I never sensed — because hopefully what one is conveying is enthusiasm for the music. I’m trying to say look, I’ve so much enjoyed hearing what you do, and participating in what you do, that I want to find out more and tell people something about you. And I don’t think that’s an unwelcome message for most people. Sometimes you…
Do you have to balance what you want to write about and what an editor might want you to write about?
